entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly attested as Legatus Augusti pr. pr. of Arabia.

segments.name_variants: C. Allius Fuscianus, [Αἰλλ]ιος Φουσκιανός, C. Allius C. f. Fuscianus
segments.identification_and_sources: honoratur titulis Gerasenis III 118 = 14156^8 (1), Journ. Rom. stud. 18, 1928, 160 (2).
segments.offices_and_career: Legatus Augusti pr. pr. (Arabiae), consul designatus t. 1, consul (suffectus anno incerto saec. II medii) t. 2. Idem videtur C. Allius C. f. Fuscianus, patronus ordinis senatorii complurium collegiorum Ostiensium, qui nominatur in titulis Ostiensibus a. 140 XIV 246, a. 152 XIV...
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Identified with the C. Allius C. f. Fuscianus, patron of the senatorial order of several Ostian guilds, attested in 140 and 152 AD.

governorship_factoids.date_text: vor dem Konsulat; auf dem Gerasa-Titel consul designatus
notes: In der PIR 'consul (suffectus anno incerto saec. II medii)' — die Klammer markiert Erschlossenes (belegt nur 'consul'); diese Datierung gilt dem KONSULAT, nicht der Statthalterschaft. Arabia-Statthalterschaft (CIL III 118 = 14156^3, Gerasa) faellt kurz vor das Konsulat (dort consul designatus). Moegliche Identitaet mit C. Allius C. f. Fuscianus (Ostia a. 140, a. 152).

career_factoids.exact_text: consul (suffectus anno incerto saec. II medii)
patronus ordinis senatorii complurium collegiorum Ostiensium
notes: Attested in Ostian inscriptions CIL XIV 246 and another from 152 AD.

entry_notes: The identification of the Gerasene governor with the Ostian patron is highly probable.
